sentences.en: I am so exhausted because I have padded the hoof for 4 hours.
sentences.zh: 我已经累坏了，因为我已经走了四个小时。

sentences.en: The shoe fell off the horse's hoof.
sentences.zh: 马蹄上的铁掌掉了下来。

sentences.en: The farrier fitted the shoe to the horse's hoof while the shoe was hot.
sentences.zh: 铁匠趁铁掌还热的时候给马蹄装上了。
